lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the reviewer-flagged CRITICAL false negative in isCommandPosition (src/issues/self-contaminating-search.ts): the left-context allowlist did not accept an opening quote at all, so a tool word appearing immediately after `-c '` or `-c "` (e.g. `bash -c 'grep -rl zzqqx scripts'`, `sh -c "rg -l zzqqx scripts/cam"`) was never recognized as an invocation -- this is the project's own dominant oracle idiom (US-003's own AC3 oracle is literally a `bash -c '...'` wrapper). The allowlist's `xargs` check also required direct adjacency to the tool word, so `env FOO=1 grep ...`, `sudo grep ...`, `xargs -0 grep ...`, and `xargs -n1 grep ...` all fell through unflagged (an intervening flag or VAR=value assignment defeated the match). Fixed with two additions: (1) `isShellDashCQuoteOpen(command, quoteIndex)` recognizes an opening quote as command position ONLY when the token immediately preceding that quote (ignoring whitespace) is exactly the shell interpreter's `-c` flag -- deliberately scoped to `-c` specifically (not every opening quote), because a blanket accept-all-quotes rule regressed the existing round-1 regression test `grep -q "rg" scripts/cam/patterns.md` (a quoted search NEEDLE to an unrelated flag, `-q`, is also an opening-quote-adjacent tool word but is not an invocation); verified this regression empirically (bun test caught it) before landing the narrower `-c`-scoped fix. (2) `hasCommandPrefixWord(command, end)` walks backward through the whitespace-separated words ending at `end`, skipping any run of flag (`-0`, `-n1`, ...) or `VAR=value` assignment tokens, to find an allowlisted prefix word now widened from just `xargs` to `xargs`/`env`/`sudo`/`time`/`command`. Extracted `precedingWord` and `hasCommandPrefixWord` as separate functions (rather than inlining the backward scan in `isCommandPosition`) specifically to satisfy the project's Biome `noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity` lint ceiling (max 15) -- the first inline version scored 18 and `bun run check:all` failed on `lint`; extracting the two helpers brought `isCommandPosition` itself back under the ceiling with zero behavior change (verified via the same 8 repro commands both before and after the extraction). Verified all 8 of the reviewer's measured repro commands from the story notes now return the correct non-null root (`bash -c 'grep -rl zzqqx scripts'`, `bash -c "grep -rl zzqqx scripts"`, `sh -c "rg -l zzqqx scripts/cam"`, `bash -c 'test -n "$(grep -rl zzqqx scripts)"'` [this one already worked, since the inner grep is preceded by `$(` not a bare quote -- the round-1 char class already covered it; only the outer quote-adjacency case was the actual gap], `env FOO=1 grep -rl zzqqx scripts`, `sudo grep -rl zzqqx scripts`, `xargs -0 grep -rl zzqqx scripts`, `xargs -n1 grep -rl zzqqx scripts`) and that the round-1 quoted-needle regression (`grep -q "rg" scripts/cam/patterns.md`) and the echoed-word regression (`bash -c "echo rg"`) both still correctly return null. Added 8 new tests to test/issues/self-contaminating-search.test.ts (the bash -c single/double-quote wrappers, the sh -c rg wrapper, the quoted-needle-to-unrelated-flag non-match, the env/sudo/xargs-with-flags prefixes) and 3 new tests to test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts (bash -c wrapper, sh -c rg wrapper, xargs-with-flag prefix) exercising the shared detection core through the plan-time lint rule call site; the existing round-1 test at that file's line 644 (quoted-needle passing case) already covered the non-regression, no duplicate needed. Did NOT touch the other two review-round-2 findings already filed into prd.json (US-R2-003: the existing $(...) regression test at test/issues/self-contaminating-search.test.ts is shaped to the old broken implementation with an artificially-spaced 'scripts )' that no real command has; US-R2-004: the round-1 patterns.md bullet overclaims that isCommandPosition's adjacency check 'catches the $(-prefixed real invocation' when measured against a bash -c wrapper, which is actually this story's own gap) -- those remain separate priority-3/4 stories for the next implementer(s). Did not touch prd-oracle-lint.ts or its non-test source: that module only imports and wraps findStoreReachingSearch, so fixing the shared core transparently fixes both call sites (consistent with the US-002/US-003 design intent already recorded in patterns.md). No pattern-records.jsonl file exists in this repo yet (checked again, same as prior stories), so appliedPatternIds is omitted. check:all is fully green: test 5872/5872 (+11 net from this story's additions), typecheck ok, lint ok (0 errors -- the initial implementation scored cognitive-complexity 18 on isCommandPosition against the lint ceiling of 15 and was refactored via helper extraction before landing, see nextStoryContext above), embed-vendor, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet all ok.
